description_en: Queries the alert configuration for an instance
description_zh: 获取实例配置的告警配置
kebab_example: aliyun alidns describe-cloud-gtm-instance-config-alert --accept-language en-US --client-token 1ae05db4-10e7-11ef-b126-00163e240022 --instance-id gtm-cn-wwo3a3hbz00 --config-id Config-0000011 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeCloudGtmInstanceConfigAlert

parameters.help_en:
The language of the response. Valid values:

zh-CN: Chinese.

en-US: English
parameters.help_zh:
返回值语言，取值： 
          
zh-CN：中文。

en-US：英文
parameters.name: accept_language

parameters.help_en: A client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. The client generates this value. The value must be unique among different requests. It can be up to 64 ASCII characters in length and cannot contain non-ASCII characters
parameters.help_zh: 用于保证请求的幂等性。由客户端生成该参数值，要保证在不同请求间唯一，最大值不超过64个ASCII字符，且该参数值中不能包含非ASCII字符
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Global Traffic Manager (GTM) 3.0 instance
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the instance configuration. For the same access domain name and GTM instance, you can configure both A and AAAA records. This creates two instance configurations. \`ConfigId\` uniquely identifies an instance configuration
parameters.help_zh: 域名实例配置id，相同接入域名、相同的GTM实例可以同时配置A和AAAA记录，此情况下相同的GTM实例会出现2个域名实例配置，ConfigId可以唯一标识域名实例配置
parameters.name: config_id

AlertMode.description_en:
The alert configuration mode for the instance.

global: The instance inherits the global alert configuration.

instance_config: The instance uses a custom alert configuration
AlertMode.description_zh:
实例告警配置模式：

global：继承全局报警配置，即实例采用全局告警配置

instance_config：自定义报警配置

ConfigId.description_en: The ID of the instance configuration. For the same access domain name and GTM instance, you can configure both A and AAAA records. This creates two instance configurations. \`ConfigId\` uniquely identifies an instance configuration
ConfigId.description_zh: 域名实例配置id，相同接入域名、相同的GTM实例可以同时配置A和AAAA记录，此情况下相同的GTM实例会出现2个域名实例配置，ConfigId可以唯一标识域名实例配置

InstanceId.description_en: The ID of the GTM 3.0 instance

RequestId.description_en: The unique ID of the request
